summary.text:
Global equities faced broad declines, with the Nikkei 225 falling 2.6% to 57117.1094 and the DAX sliding 1.12% to 24736.9902. In the US, the Nasdaq 100 slipped 0.64% to 26046.8965, weighed down by Nvidia dropping 3.91% to 149.3, which helped drive the VIX up 7.32% to 28.29. Conversely, the Dow Jones added 0.33% to 50182.9492, and AST SpaceMobile surged 10.25% to 26.02 following US approval of a SpaceX satellite initiative.

The dollar index slipped 0.11% to 103.696, with EUR/USD rising 0.1% to 1.0973 and USD/JPY edging down to 159.112. Energy was unchanged, with Brent at 90.67 and WTI at 84.05, while gold sat flat at 3602.2. Bitcoin gained 1.99% to 60934.8906.

Attention turns to the French 2027 budget after the Senate approved a five-billion-euro levy on large corporations, while Crown PropTech shareholders approved a merger with Mkango Rare Earths.
